description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the 'Receiver' class in the package 'org.eclipse.hono.cli.app'. It sets up mock objects and verifies the behavior of the Receiver, particularly its start method with different message types ('telemetry', 'event', 'all') and invalid inputs.

classes.name: ReceiverTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the Receiver component, testing its startup behavior with different message types and invalid inputs.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the Receiver with mocked dependencies before each test.

methods.name: testTelemetryStart
methods.description: Test verifying successful start of Receiver when message.type is 'telemetry'.

methods.name: testEventStart
methods.description: Test verifying successful start when message.type is 'event'.

methods.name: testDefaultStart
methods.description: Test verifying successful start when message.type is 'all'.

methods.name: testInvalidTypeStart
methods.description: Test verifying that Receiver fails to start with an invalid message.type.
